nodes.name: Main Entrance
nodes.visual_cue: Big glass doors with the college name above

nodes.name: Reception Desk
nodes.visual_cue: Wooden desk with a 'May I help you' board

nodes.name: Main Corridor
nodes.visual_cue: Long corridor with a green notice board

nodes.name: Washroom (Ground Floor)
nodes.visual_cue: Blue door with a washroom sign

nodes.name: Canteen
nodes.visual_cue: Open hall with tables and a tea counter

nodes.name: Side Exit
nodes.visual_cue: Green EXIT sign over a metal door

nodes.name: Stairs (First Floor)
nodes.visual_cue: Top of the stairs, fire extinguisher on the wall

nodes.name: Library
nodes.visual_cue: Double doors with a LIBRARY sign

edges.hint_forward: Walk in. The reception desk is straight ahead
edges.hint_backward: Walk out through the big glass doors behind you

edges.hint_forward: Turn left after the reception desk
edges.hint_backward: Turn right and walk to the reception desk

edges.hint_forward: Walk down the corridor. The washroom is on your right after the notice board
edges.hint_backward: Come out and turn left. Walk back to the notice board

edges.hint_forward: Go straight to the end of the corridor
edges.hint_backward: Come out of the canteen and go straight down the corridor

edges.hint_forward: Inside the canteen, the exit is on your left
edges.hint_backward: Come back in. The canteen is on your right

edges.hint_forward: Turn right at the notice board. The stairs are in front of you
edges.hint_backward: Come down the stairs and turn left

edges.hint_forward: Go up the stairs to the first floor
edges.hint_backward: Go down the stairs to the ground floor

edges.hint_forward: At the top of the stairs, turn left. Room 104 is the second door
edges.hint_backward: Come out of Room 104 and turn right. Walk to the stairs

edges.hint_forward: At the top of the stairs, turn right and walk to the end
edges.hint_backward: Come out of the library and walk straight to the stairs
